newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement falls to 4.946 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement falls to 4.946 mln gallons.

text.p: The Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended February 22 was 4,946,186 gallons compared with 5,594,594 gallons last week.
Imports were 944,505 gallons compared with 1,108,956 gallons the previous week.
There were no domestic receipts this week or the previous week.
Retail movement was 1,163,013 gallons, while bulk movement was 3,280,817 gallons.
Current season cumulative movement was 61,800,841 gallons.
The final total pack for the season is 147,526,166 gallons.
